title: Exponential variance of paired determinant estimates for optical circuit readout
description: A shared-sign pair of determinants estimates a normalized optical-circuit acceptance probability without bias. On an explicit family of connected circuits its variance grows exponentially for every positive entry weighting fixed before sampling. Deleting any single central controlled-sign gate changes the promised decision. The proof computes the optical amplitude on the complement of alternating cycles. A second construction uses independent controls. Both decision families are classically tractable.
